label: Project
description: One profile per project inside a knowledge domain (DECISION-1): what a project's Claude reads first. Identity is the project's KB_APP term — the term, not a spelling, so a rename is a label/alias change and documents keep resolving. Documents belong to a project through their optional `app` field. `tooling` is an optional archive of project-specific tooling a user downloads and unpacks. usage:reference (master data other documents point at by `app`).
